closedFacts.allocationFailure: SD_StartAlias calls SND_StopVoice and returns failure
closedFacts.allocationSuccess: returned sd_voice* is stored in the driver-voice array and SND_SetVoiceStartInfo is called
closedFacts.loadedDataPointer: entry+0x08 offset plus selected runtime bank loaded-data base at bank+0x127C
closedFacts.physicalEntrySearch: binary search over the sorted physical SndAssetBankEntry array

dispatch.ramPool: voice index > 9; calls SND_AssetBankFindLoaded with SndAlias+0x10, validates physical metadata, then calls SD_VoiceAllocateRam
dispatch.secondaryBoundary: SD_StartAlias has no Secondary-alias fallback. assetId==0 is not a Secondary sentinel here; physical SND_AssetBankFindEntry additionally asserts the requested id is nonzero.
dispatch.streamPool: voice index <= 9; exact code requires SndAlias.flags0 loadType bits15-16 to be SA_STREAMED(2) or SA_PRIMED(3), then calls SND_AssetBankFindStreamed with SndAlias+0x10

driverAllocation.commonAcquire: both allocators first call exact helper 0x008BA1C0 and return null if no sd_voice is obtained
driverAllocation.ram: initializes RAM state, calls exact helper 0x008B9B20, marks state 3 and returns null if setup fails, otherwise sets data-ready +0x08=1 and state=2 before returning sd_voice*
driverAllocation.stream: initializes stream state via exact helper 0x008B9D10; a nonzero +0x44 setup-failure state returns null; the success path calls exact helper 0x008B9B20, copies entry byte +0x11 to sd_voice+0x10C, sets state=2, and returns sd_voice*
driverAllocation.unnamedHelpers: 0x008BA1C0, 0x008B9B20, and 0x008B9D10 remain address-only until their MAP/PDB names and deeper semantics are independently closed.

notYetEstablished: full names/prototypes of driver helpers 0x008BA1C0, 0x008B9B20, and 0x008B9D10
codec-specific sample decode below the sd_voice/backend setup layer

physicalSearch.algorithm: inclusive low/high binary search; midpoint=(low+high)/2; entry=base+midpoint*20; compare uint32 entry+0x00 with requested id; equality stores the exact entry pointer
physicalSearch.runtimeLoaded: SND_AssetBankFindLoaded scans 32 bank slots under critical section 11, passes the exact id/table/count to physical SND_AssetBankFindEntry, rejects entry+0x08 == 0xFFFFFFFF, and optionally returns loadedBase+offset
physicalSearch.runtimeStreamed: the overloaded SND_AssetBankFindEntry scans 32 bank slots under critical section 11, selects the streamed descriptor when selector=true, requires its valid byte, derives the physical entry table, and passes the exact id to physical SND_AssetBankFindEntry

proofBoundary: Only exact SHA-pinned PC dedicated-server machine code and exact MAP symbol bindings are authoritative. This closes the assetId-to-bank-entry-to-driver-voice handoff for this build. It does not claim retail t6mp.exe equivalence or codec decode semantics.
